title: List of Nightfall missions and primary quests
wikitext:
This is a list of all the [[mission]]s and primary quests in [[Guild Wars Nightfall]], taking you through the [[storyline]], as well as the [[challenge mission]]s. Characters from non-Nightfall campaigns who travel to [[Elona]] will join the storyline at [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] with the quest [[Battle Preparations]].

== Storyline missions ==
===[[Istan]]===
:;Either
::[[Rally the Recruits (Tutorial)]] → [[Into Chahbek Village]]
:;Or
::[[Take the Shortcut (Skip Tutorial)]]
:;1. [[Chahbek Village]] <small>(Required hero: [[Koss]])</small>
::[[Primary Training]] → [[Honing your Skills]] → [[Secondary Training]] → [[Choose Your Secondary Profession (Nightfall)|Choose Your Secondary Profession]] → [[Leaving a Legacy]] → [[The Honorable General]] → [[Signs and Portents]]
:;2. [[Jokanur Diggings]] <small>(Required hero: [[Melonni]])</small>
::[[Isle of the Dead (quest)|Isle of the Dead]] → [[Bad Tide Rising]] → [[Special Delivery]] → [[Big News, Small Package]] → [[Following the Trail]]
:;3. [[Blacktide Den]] <small>(Required hero: [[Tahlkora]])</small>
::[[The Iron Truth]] → [[Trial by Fire]] → [[War Preparations (Ghost Reconnaissance)]], [[War Preparations (Recruit Training)]] and [[War Preparations (Wind and Water)]] → [[The Time is Nigh]]

<hr>
:''Characters from other campaigns will begin here and follow this quest chain:''
::[[Battle Preparations]] → [[Securing Champion's Dawn]] → [[A Land of Heroes]] → [[The Time is Nigh]]
<hr>

===[[Kourna]]===
:;4. [[Consulate Docks]] <small>(Required hero: [[Dunkoro]])</small>
::[[Hunted!]] → [[The Great Escape]] → [[And a Hero Shall Lead Them]]
:;5. [[Venta Cemetery]] <small>(Required hero: Koss)</small>
::[[The Council is Called]] → [[To Vabbi!]] → [[Centaur Blackmail]]
:;6. [[Kodonur Crossroads]] <small>(Required hero: [[Zhed Shadowhoof]])</small>
::[[Mysterious Message (Nightfall quest)|Mysterious Message]]

:[[Image:Disambig icon.png|21px]] ''The storyline divides in two paths here, depending on whether you choose [[Margrid the Sly]] or [[Master of Whispers]]. These paths are '''mutually exclusive''', so you can only get one of the heroes (at this time). If you wish to do the other mission (not quest), you can finish the campaign, or join a party that contains the other hero.''

:;Either
::([[Margrid the Sly]]) [[For a Price]] → [[No Me, No Kormir]] 
::;7a. [[Pogahn Passage]] <small>(Required hero: Margrid the Sly)</small>
:;Or
::([[Master of Whispers]]) [[Secrets in the Shadow]] → [[To Kill a Demon]] 
::;7b. [[Rilohn Refuge]] <small>(Required hero: Master of Whispers)</small>

:''Storyline rejoins for...''
:;8. [[Moddok Crevice]] <small>(Required hero: Dunkoro)</small>

===[[Vabbi]]===
::[[Rally The Princes]]
:;9. [[Tihark Orchard]]
::[[All's Well That Ends Well]] → [[Warning Kehanni]]

:[[Image:Disambig icon.png|21px]] ''Once again, the storyline divides in two possible paths, depending on which hero you chose in the previous fork, Margrid the Sly or Master of Whispers.''

:;Either
::(Margrid the Sly) [[Greed and Regret]]
::;10a. [[Dasha Vestibule]] <small>(Required hero: Margrid the Sly)</small>
:;Or
::(Master of Whispers) [[Calling the Order]]
::;10b. [[Dzagonur Bastion]] <small>(Required hero: Master of Whispers)</small>

:''Storyline rejoins for...''
::[[Pledge of the Merchant Princes]]
:;11. [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] <small>(Required hero: Tahlkora)</small>
::[[Attack at the Kodash]] <small>(Required heroes: Koss and Melonni)</small>

:[[Image:Disambig icon.png|21px]] ''This is the third fork in the storyline, as the player is presented with two possible paths, depending on whether you choose to defend the village of Ronjok in Kourna or help the Vabbians with the Nightfallen Garden of Seborhin. Note that these are '''not''' mutually exclusive, both can be completed, but only one is needed to continue the storyline. Nundu Bay is considered easier.''

:;Either
::[[Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger]]
::;12a. [[Jennur's Horde]] <small>(Required hero: Koss)</small>
:;Or
::[[Heart or Mind: Ronjok in Danger]]
::;12b. [[Nundu Bay]] <small>(Required hero: Melonni)</small>

:''Storyline rejoins for...''
::[[Crossing the Desolation]]

===[[The Desolation]]===
:;13. [[Gate of Desolation]] <small>(Required hero: Zhed Shadowhoof)</small>
::[[A Deal's a Deal]] → [[Horde of Darkness]] 
:;14. [[Ruins of Morah]] <small>(Required hero: [[General Morgahn]])</small>

===[[Realm of Torment]]===
::[[Uncharted Territory]]
:;15. [[Gate of Pain]] <small>(Required hero: Dunkoro)</small>
::[[Kormir's Crusade]] → [[All Alone in the Darkness]]
:;16. [[Gate of Madness]]
:;17. [[Abaddon's Gate]]
